Scout.abilityText:
Rifleman: When you declare an attack, replace 1 die in your attack pool with 1 blue die.

Priority Target: Figures do not block line of sight for your attacks.

Senator.abilityText: Conspire: Distribute 1 Focus for each die in your printed attack pool to friendly figures within 1 space.

Soldier.abilityText:
Shields Up: Place 1 energy shield in an adjacent space. A figure can attack this energy shield (Health 4, Defense: None).

Professional: While attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die.

Streetrat.abilityText:
Assassin's Blade: After this attack resolves, choose an adjacent hostile figure and roll 1 red die. That figure suffers damage equal to the Hit results.

Fleet: At the start of your activation, gain 2 movement points.
